thread:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — high 5xx rate in sa-west during blue/green rollout for inference-api. 5xx = 11% over 3m. Paging oncall @Jordan.
Jordan: acked. I’m on it, grabbing metrics + logs.
Santiago: I’m seeing green pool health checks failing in cloud-dns for the new instances (green). Old blue looks fine. Errors are mostly 502 from edge.
Maya: any DNS weight change recent?
Alex: we flipped weights to 25% green ~04:12 UTC as part of rollout.
Priya: error traces show downstream connection resets to model hosts on green nodes, TLS handshake timeouts.
Jordan: can we throttle traffic to green immediately? Need kill-switch if possible.
Santiago: I can flip the rollout flag. Internal toggle is `sa-rollout-weight` in config service. Setting to 0 will force 100% to blue.
Maya: do it. that’s the fastest mitigation. +1
Santiago: executing now.
Santiago: ```
# internal-config-cli
configctl set sa-rollout-weight 0 --service inference-api --env prod
```
Santiago: done — reported success from config service.
incident-bot: Config change detected: `sa-rollout-weight` -> 0 by Santiago.
Jordan: watching errors... 5xx dropping, now 2.1% and trending down.
Alex: confirm traffic back to blue instances only. logs show green pool drained.
Priya: customers impacted — support tickets show 3 enterprise customers in SA with failed requests and one spike in latency. Raising to S3 affect.
Maya: good mitigation. Can we keep rollout paused and run deeper health checks on green images?
Santiago: yes. I’ll isolate one green host and run a local repro. Preliminary: env var mismatch in model-init causing TLS session negotiation errors.
Alex: if it’s env mismatch we should pin rollback image used in green and re-run tests. But we should also capture config drift in deploy pipeline.
Jordan: for ops: I’ll notify support and temporary SLA exceptions. Priya — can you draft an impact summary and list affected customers?
Priya: on it. Drafting now, will ping legal for notification wording.
Maya: postmortem owners? I can lead infra analysis for the rollout pipeline. Santiago can do the model-init debug. Alex do we want to run a safe canary plan?
Alex: yes — smaller weight increments, health probe extended to 60s, and synthetic traffic checks from SA edge. Also add a pre-rollout smoke for TLS handshake.
Santiago: created incident ticket INC-2026-sa-rollout-179123 (link) and added notes.
Jordan: handing off to Maya for the 12:00 UTC shift. I’ll remain reachable for 30m.
Maya: taking over. Thanks.
incident-bot: oncall handoff — alert routed to Maya at 04:42 UTC.
Priya: impact summary (brief): ~4% of requests in SA region failed during 04:10-04:25 UTC. 3 paying customers reported errors, no data loss. Action taken: rollback traffic to blue, pausing rollout. Next steps: reproduce on isolated green host, fix env mismatch, add rollout gating.
Alex: note to add automated verification step: validate TLS handshake success before weight > 0.
Santiago: repro steps saved in the ticket. Will attach server logs and core dump.
Maya: thanks team. Will schedule a follow-up postmortem and assign action items.
Jordan: closing the active pager — metrics stable and support notifications sent.
incident-bot: Pager resolved by Jordan. Incident marked: mitigated.
Maya: creating postmortem draft now, will ping authors for 24h review window. :memo:
